mapper.select: SELECT * FROM zentide_source_application WHERE application_id=#{applicationId} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM zentide_source_application ORDER BY FIELD(status,'SUBMITTED','APPROVED','TRIAL_FAILED','TRIAL_PASSED','ACTIVATED','REJECTED'), created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM zentide_topic WHERE topic_id=#{topicId} AND status='ACTIVE' LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE zentide_source_application SET status=#{status},review_note=#{note},reviewer_account=#{actor},reviewed_at=#{at} WHERE application_id=#{applicationId} AND status=#{expected}
UPDATE zentide_source_application SET status='TRIAL_RUNNING' WHERE application_id=#{applicationId} AND status IN ('APPROVED','TRIAL_FAILED')
UPDATE zentide_source_application SET status=#{status},trial_result_json=#{result},trialed_at=#{at} WHERE application_id=#{applicationId} AND status='TRIAL_RUNNING'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM zentide_source WHERE canonical_url_hash=#{urlHash} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE zentide_source_application SET status='ACTIVATED',source_id=#{sourceId},reviewer_account=#{actor},activated_at=#{at} WHERE application_id=#{applicationId} AND status='TRIAL_PASSED'
